title.zh: Hugging Face称其数据管道被具备代理能力的AI系统入侵
title.en: Hugging Face says an agentic AI system hacked its data pipeline, accessing several internal clusters and credentials; its own AI-based triage caught the breach

summary.zh: Hugging Face表示，一个具备代理能力的AI系统入侵了其数据管道，访问了多个内部集群和凭据，但其基于AI的分诊系统检测到了此次入侵。

title.zh: 阿里巴巴推出2.4万亿参数的Qwen3.8 Max预览版
title.en: Alibaba launches a 2.4T parameter Qwen3.8 Max preview that it says rivals frontier AI models and is second only to Fable 5, plans to make it “open-weight soon”

summary.zh: 阿里巴巴发布了Qwen3.8 Max预览版，号称其性能可与前沿AI模型竞争，仅次于Fable 5，并计划很快开源其权重。

title.zh: 消息称CIA特工调查G42与中国的关系并协助阿联酋获取AI芯片
title.en: Sources: CIA operative Jonny Gannon spied on G42 to probe its China ties and helped the UAE gain expanded access to US AI chips by allaying US suspicions

summary.zh: 消息人士透露，CIA特工Jonny Gannon调查了G42与中国的关系，并帮助阿联酋通过缓解美国的疑虑来扩大对美国AI芯片的访问权限。

title.zh: 分析：开源模型的网络能力落后于前沿闭源模型4到7个月
title.en: Analysis: recent open weight models lag frontier closed models' cyber capabilities by 4 to 7 months, a narrower gap than the 6 to 10 months through most of 2025

summary.zh: 分析显示，近期开源权重模型在网络能力方面落后于前沿闭源模型4到7个月，这一差距比2025年大部分时间的6到10个月有所缩小。

title.zh: 中国国家AI产业投资基金通过加入DeepSeek的74亿美元融资获得投票权
title.en: Sources: China's National AI Industry Investment Fund gained voting rights in DeepSeek by joining its $7.4B round; other investors like Tencent and JD got none

summary.zh: 消息称，中国国家AI产业投资基金通过参与DeepSeek的74亿美元融资获得了投票权，而其他投资者如腾讯和京东则未获得。

title.zh: AI正在重塑入门级专业服务工作
title.en: AI is reshaping entry-level professional services jobs, as companies redesign hiring, training, and workplace culture rather than simply cut junior roles

summary.zh: 公司正在重新设计招聘、培训和工作文化，而不是简单地削减初级职位，AI正在改变入门级专业服务工作的面貌。

title.zh: 特朗普政府如何从“轻触”AI政策转向干预主义立场
title.en: How the Trump administration shifted from a “light-touch” approach to AI policy to an interventionist stance that led to restrictions on top AI models in the US

summary.zh: 分析特朗普政府如何从宽松的AI政策转向干预主义立场，最终导致对美国顶尖AI模型的限制。

title.zh: 非营利组织Current AI获得4亿美元承诺资金支持
title.en: A look at the nonprofit Current AI, backed by $400M in commitments from many partners including $100M from France, that's funding open, public AI infrastructure

summary.zh: 非营利组织Current AI获得包括法国1亿美元在内的多方合作伙伴的4亿美元承诺资金，用于资助开放的公共AI基础设施。

title.zh: 中国BrainCo推出全球首个脑控机器人平台
title.en: China's BrainCo unveils what it says is the world's first integrated “brain-to-robot” platform that lets users control robots using an EEG headset

summary.zh: BrainCo发布了全球首个集成的“脑控机器人”平台，用户可通过脑电图（EEG）头戴设备控制机器人。

title.zh: 日本计划购买27,500颗Nvidia Rubin芯片开发AI基础模型
title.en: Japan plans to buy 27,500 Nvidia Rubin chips to develop a domestic AI foundation model for robots, in a Noetra-led effort that includes SoftBank, Sony, and NEC

summary.zh: 日本计划购买27,500颗Nvidia Rubin芯片，用于开发国内的机器人AI基础模型，此项目由Noetra牵头，软银、索尼和NEC参与。

title.zh: AI 创业公司 Thira 获得 2100 万美元种子轮融资，专注于开发处理后台任务的 AI 代理
title.en: Thira, an AI startup founded by Apptio co-founders to develop AI agents that handle back-office tasks such as IT support, raised a $21M seed led by Madrona

summary.zh: Thira 由 Apptio 联合创始人创立，专注于开发用于 IT 支持等后台任务的 AI 代理，融资由 Madrona 领投。

title.zh: 数据基础设施初创公司 Cribl 收购 AI 威胁检测工具公司 CardinalOps
title.en: Data infrastructure startup Cribl acquires CardinalOps, which offers AI-powered threat detection tools and had raised $40M, sources say for around $100M

summary.zh: CardinalOps 曾筹集 4000 万美元，据消息称此次收购金额约为 1 亿美元。

title.zh: 阿里巴巴开源芯片软件，助力中国 GPU 厂商打破 Nvidia CUDA 的主导地位
title.en: Alibaba open-sources its chip software, following similar plays from Huawei and Moore Threads, as Chinese GPU makers try to break the dominance of Nvidia's CUDA

summary.zh: 阿里巴巴跟随华为和摩尔线程的脚步，开源其芯片软件，旨在推动中国 GPU 行业的技术自主。
